phase8Checklist: Review every SHOULD COMMIT source/test/migration/sample/doc/tool file, including additions from earlier phases. Stage the removed obsolete sample too.
Ensure machine-specific research helpers are described as provenance tooling, not portable normal setup. Parameterize defaults later only if needed for publication.
Publish a reviewed source commit/archive identity; published HEAD currently lacks the integrated state.
Choose explicit evidence delivery. Keep complete frozen packages plus original hash manifests, and document artifact download locations if not in Git.
Do not publish populated env files, gateway/bridge/provider secrets or database passwords. No blanket git add -f or git add . over raw local data.
Exclude cache/build/temporary paths; review sanitized small result summaries separately. Keep all negative findings and original failures.
Recheck clean-checkout links after the chosen artifact publication; current links are verified locally, not promised present at published HEAD.
